tools.label: 3D
tools.tagline: Tilts the map and shows terrain.

tools.tagline: Shows which map engine is being used.

tools.label: Attribution
tools.tagline: The credit your data requires, kept legible.

tools.tagline: Creates a zone at a set distance around a layer.

tools.tagline: Resizes regions by a numeric value.

tools.label: Compare
tools.tagline: Compares the current map with later changes.

tools.tagline: Shows pointer coordinates in the chosen format.

tools.label: Data analyzer
tools.tagline: Finds useful fields, statistical families, and map-making options in a layer.

tools.tagline: Shows reconstructed coastlines from deep time.

tools.label: Draw
tools.tagline: Adds points, lines and areas to the map, with your own fields.

tools.label: Fullscreen
tools.tagline: Fills the screen with the map.

tools.label: Geolocation
tools.tagline: Shows your location and optional track.

tools.tagline: Builds a new layer from one or two existing layers.

tools.label: Import layer
tools.tagline: Adds layers from a service URL.

tools.label: Feature info
tools.tagline: Shows the attributes at a point on the map.

tools.label: Inset map
tools.tagline: Shows where the main map is.

tools.label: Isochrone
tools.tagline: Shows where you can get within a chosen time or distance.

tools.label: Legend 3D
tools.tagline: Shows map layers as a 3D stack.

tools.label: Legend
tools.tagline: Lists the layers on the map.

tools.label: Catalog
tools.tagline: Lets readers choose layers from a grouped catalog.

tools.label: Map language
tools.tagline: Changes the language used for map labels.

tools.label: Measure
tools.tagline: Measures lengths, areas and perimeters by clicking on the map.

tools.label: Tools
tools.tagline: Puts several tools behind one menu button.

tools.label: Navigation
tools.tagline: Provides zoom buttons and a compass.

tools.label: Print
tools.tagline: Prints the current map view.

tools.label: Projection
tools.tagline: Changes the map projection.

tools.label: Routing
tools.tagline: Finds a route, distance and travel time.

tools.label: Scale bar
tools.tagline: Shows the current map scale.

tools.label: Sea level

tools.label: Search
tools.tagline: Finds a place by name and moves the map there.

tools.label: Settings
tools.tagline: Changes theme, style, engine, and API keys.

tools.label: Spinner
tools.tagline: Shows when the map is busy.

tools.label: Stories
tools.tagline: Guides readers through a map step by step.

tools.label: Time
tools.tagline: Sets the time used by time-based layers.

tools.label: Toolbox
tools.tagline: Puts several tools behind one icon row.
